analysis.title: Gilead Sciences, Inc. 3Q26 Preview: Expecting a déjà vu kind of quarter, with call to focus on Immunology
key_insights: Barclays expects GILD's 3Q26 print to look similar to 2Q26, with a beat in HIV driven largely by US pricing and mix. Barclays is +2% vs. Bloomberg consensus on revenue and adjusted EPS.
Barclays' above-consensus revenue estimate is driven by the HIV business, mostly Biktarvy and Descovy. It is mostly in line on other products.

Yeztugo: Barclays sees limited room to beat current consensus based on 3Q script trends. Buy-and-bill share could add variance. Consensus of $285mm implies +23% q/q (vs. +40% q/q in 2Q) and Barclays is in line with the Street.
Bixlenvo (BIC/LEN) was approved for the switch market on 8/27/26. Barclays expects minimal initial sales in 3Q, likely from inventory stocking.
Trodelvy should keep performing well on first-line TNBC uptake. Barclays is slightly above consensus.
FY26 guidance could be nudged higher on US HIV. At 2Q26, HIV business growth guidance was raised to +9-10% (from +8%) and FY26 product revenue to $30.1-30.4bn (from $30.0-30.4bn).

The call is expected to focus on Immunology after the emvistegrast ulcerative colitis readout at UEGW and the purchase of an oral anti-IL23 inhibitor. Barclays calls the initial emvistegrast data somewhat encouraging, with cross-trial comparisons difficult.
The move into Phase 3 and the commitment to combinations signal that Gilead is committed to Immunology development.
The IRAK4 inhibitor edecesertib has Phase 2 lupus data at ACR (November 6-11). Barclays calls it a small proof-of-concept data set.
This is the last earnings call before the anito-cel PDUFA date of 12/23/26, so Barclays expects significant discussion of it.

Management: ACA subsidy expiry reduced HIV treatment volumes, which management calls temporary. Management expects 2-3% treatment market growth. Biktarvy absorbed a Florida ADAP impact that should reverse over a few quarters.
Management does not plan to update Yeztugo persistency quarterly unless it moves meaningfully from about 70%. Buy-and-bill came in ahead of management's expectations at the start of the year.

Anito-cel: Gilead will launch with five times the authorized treatment centers Carvykti had at launch. Center activation runs through 1H27 and sales begin in 2027. A filing in 2L-4L multiple myeloma could come in 2027.
Barclays raised FY26-FY30E revenue to $30.9bn in FY26E, $32.2bn in FY27E and $37.6bn in FY30E. The largest increase is in FY28E (+$741m, +2.2%).
Barclays raised opex and cut FY29-FY30 adjusted operating profit. FY30E adjusted operating margin falls to 48.1% from 50.6%. FY27E adjusted EPS rises 3.7% to $9.52 and FY30E falls 2.2% to $11.44.
Rating Equal Weight and $145 PT unchanged, set at 15x FY27E adjusted EPS of $9.52. DCF NPV is about $144 per share, up from $140.15. The $145 target is 8.6% below the $158.69 price.

market_movers.rationale: Barclays keeps Equal Weight with a $145 PT, 8.6% below the $158.69 price. It sees durable HIV growth but views the shares as appropriately valued.

sector_views.rationale: Barclays industry view is Neutral, unchanged.

earnings_insights: GILD 3Q26 Barclays estimates vs. Bloomberg consensus: revenue $7,907mm vs. $7,789mm consensus (+2%). Adjusted EPS $2.26 vs. $2.21 consensus per the variance table (the table also lists $2.23 for the IPR&D-adjusted consensus). Both are estimates, not reported results.

3Q26 Barclays est. vs. Bloomberg consensus: Biktarvy $3,961mm vs. $3,892mm, Descovy $982mm vs. $920mm, Yeztugo $286mm vs. $285mm, Trodelvy $470mm vs. $464mm. Total product sales are $7,864mm vs. $7,732mm.
3Q26 Barclays est. vs. Bloomberg consensus: Bixlenvo $5mm (no consensus), Veklury $62mm vs. $62mm, royalty revenue $42mm vs. $57mm. Estimated adjusted EPS ex-IPR&D is $2.28 vs. $2.27 consensus.
Reported 2Q26 adjusted EPS was -$6.75, reflecting about $9.02 per share of acquired IPR&D. Reported 3Q25 adjusted EPS was $2.47.

Barclays FY26E adjusted EPS is -$0.31 (consensus -$0.44 in the EPS table, -$0.48 in the variance table), including about $9.15 per share of IPR&D. Excluding IPR&D, FY26E is $8.85 vs. $8.67 consensus. Company non-GAAP EPS guidance is -$0.57 to -$0.22.

FY26 guidance: product sales $30.1-30.4bn (Barclays $30,627mm, consensus $30,332mm), Yeztugo sales about $1.0bn, HIV growth 9-10% (Barclays 10.5%), operating income ex-IPR&D $14.4-14.8bn (Barclays $14,872mm).
Barclays FY27E adjusted EPS is $9.52 vs. consensus $9.90. Quarterly consensus is $2.49 for 3Q and $2.81 for 4Q in the Cons column of the EPS table.
risk_factors: Barclays' downside risks: a worse-than-anticipated Yeztugo launch or worse-than-anticipated Trodelvy uptake. Upside risks are the reverse.
ACA subsidy expiry has reduced HIV treatment volumes and could slow Biktarvy more than expected.
Payer negotiations and US drug pricing policy could change where HIV pricing lands. Management would not say where price ultimately lands.
Barclays' costs grow faster than revenue from FY29E, lowering adjusted operating margin.
IEC-HS (a CAR-T class warning) applies to all CAR-T products. The in vivo CAR-T programs are early with open safety questions.

tension_points.bull_case: Barclays expects price and mix tailwinds in US HIV to drive an above-consensus 3Q26 and a further FY26 guidance raise. Management says buy-and-bill is running ahead of plan and Descovy and Yeztugo give it payer leverage in PrEP.
tension_points.bear_case: ACA subsidy expiry has cut treatment volumes and Biktarvy absorbed the Florida ADAP impact. Payer negotiations continue, and management would not say where price lands. Barclays' PT sits 8.6% below the current price.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Barclays flags a worse-than-anticipated Yeztugo launch or weaker Trodelvy uptake as the downside risks. It says Yeztugo beats are limited given 3Q script trends.
